name: Fujinoki Touya
source: Satoshi's classmate, and his good friend ever since the opening ceremony. He sometimes say some outrageous things and you never knew what's going through his head, but he's a really dependable, kind friend. He's working at this father's production agency as the manager of the local idol, RIN.
